name: rtfx
description: Publish HTML pages and multi-file artifacts to rtfx.pro from a Claude Code session or any MCP client — versioned, access-controlled, with a stable URL

api_token.title: rtfx.pro API token (optional)
api_token.description: A scoped token from rtfx.pro > Dashboard > Integrations (scopes: read, publish). Leave empty to sign in with a browser instead (/rtfx:login).

endpoint.title: rtfx endpoint
endpoint.description: Base URL of your rtfx instance. Leave as is for rtfx.pro; change it only for a self-hosted artifacts-server (https only).
